questions.question: Which keyword is used to inherit a class in Java?
questions.explanation: The extends keyword is used when one class inherits another class in Java.

questions.question: Which method is the entry point of a Java application?
questions.explanation: The main() method is the standard entry point of a Java application.

questions.question: Which data type is used to store true or false values?
questions.explanation: The boolean data type stores either true or false.

questions.question: Which keyword is used to create an object in Java?
questions.explanation: The new keyword is used to create an object from a class.

questions.question: Which collection does not allow duplicate elements?
questions.explanation: HashSet stores unique elements and does not allow duplicates.
